justification: StaticJavaParser.java is a broad facade: it defines 36 public static parse/config methods and each one delegates to JavaParser/JavaParserAdapter/newParser(), while importing many AST types plus ParserConfiguration and Javadoc parsing support. Fan-in is also high: `rg` found 42 production files under `**/src/main/java` referencing StaticJavaParser, including core AST classes (CompilationUnit.java, Name.java, NodeWith*.java), generators (AbstractGenerator.java, NodeMetaModelGenerator.java), serialization (JavaParserJsonDeserializer.java), and symbol-solver code (SourceFileInfoExtractor.java). This combination of wide outbound delegation and broad inbound use matches hub-like modularization.
